title: Compasslet: micro‑lens sidebar with temporal workspace ribbon
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and validate a compact, progressive-density sidebar pattern (Compasslet) paired with a temporal workspace ribbon. Aim: reduce vertical chrome, improve rapid workspace trajectory switching, and surface cost/rollout indicators in situ. Deliverables: interactive Figma prototype, annotated spec for engineering handoff, usability test notes, and accessibility checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype supports three density modes (Compact, Standard, Expanded) and persists per-user preference
Workspace ribbon displays last 5 active workspace snapshots and allows drag reorder
Cost badge surfaces per-workspace token burn and highlights anomalies >25% of baseline
Keyboard navigation: sidebar micro-lens and ribbon fully operable (tab/arrow/space)
Engineering can implement initial iteration without server-side schema changes (client-side feature flag)
Design handoff includes component props, motion specs, and responsive behavior for small viewports
decisions: Use micro-lens glyphs (icon + subtle label) for compact state rather than full-text menu to maintain scan velocity
Temporal ribbon sits above content area (not in rail) to avoid increasing sidebar complexity; ribbon state is synced to local storage for quick recovery
Cost badges will use a three-color system (neutral/alert/critical) and progressive disclosure: tooltip with 24h delta and link to cost page
Will default new users to Standard density; existing users keep current settings until opt-in
Rollout will be staged: internal-only -> beta users -> 10% canary -> full release, with feature flag gate for Dedicated tenants
user_testing_summary: Moderated sessions (N=8) with PMs and infra engineers. Key outcomes: micro‑lens improved quick-scan time by ~22% in tasks where users switched workspaces >3x; ribbon was preferred for temporal navigation but caused mild visual noise when >7 active snapshots. Recommendation: cap visible snapshots at 5 and surface an overflow menu.
accessibility_considerations: Contrast for micro-lens icons tested at AA for text >=14px
ARIA roles: use role=tablist for ribbon and ensure live region updates when cost badge changes
Ensure focus ring is visible in Compact mode; provide skip links to main content
notes: Trade-off: compact micro-lens reduces discoverability for new users; mitigated by contextual onboarding tooltip and discoverability tour
Engineering asked to expose an opt-out flag for enterprise customers requiring explicit workspace labels
Design will provide two-level iconography (glyph + micro-dot) to signal rollout state (canary/beta/stable)
We should coordinate with Optimize team to ensure cost anomaly thresholds are aligned with existing alerting rules
